company.name: Rilla
company.shortDescription: Rilla Network provides peer-to-peer video streaming technology that uses viewer bandwidth to distribute video.
company.description: Rilla is rewiring the content economy. Directing more of the value generated back to creators and their communities by leveraging audience bandwidth and rewarding them with ownership in the network.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-driven video distribution system that optimizes latency, cost, and streaming quality in real-time for live broadcasts.
productsAndServices.name: Live Video Distribution Engine

productsAndServices.description: A network that reduces CDN usage by sharing bandwidth load among viewers, lowering streaming costs by 60-90%.
productsAndServices.name: Peer-to-Peer Streaming Network

productsAndServices.description: A toolset providing real-time monitoring, analytics, and testing to maintain streaming performance and resilience.
productsAndServices.name: Streaming Analytics and Testing Suite

productsAndServices.description: A set of security measures including DRM, authentication, and P2P-based protections against DDoS attacks for streaming content.
productsAndServices.name: Security Features for Streaming

productsAndServices.description: Performance-optimized software development kits that integrate Rilla's streaming technology into various platforms with minimal complexity.
productsAndServices.name: Native SDKs for Integration

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $2,700,000, or 43.55% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,000,000 to $27,915,152, a 4.65x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 86 (-2 over 90 days) and market heat at 69 (-2).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Kollective Technology, VBrick, Hive Streaming.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
